component.name: Audius
component.summary: Gain, monitoring and routing for the RME Babyface Pro FS

description.p: A control panel for the RME Babyface Pro FS in Class Compliant mode, where RME's TotalMix FX isn't available. Set mic gain while watching a live level ring, switch between headphones and speakers, balance what you hear, and reach the full routing matrix when you need it.

ul.li: Gain dial with live levels, 48V and PAD
Listen on headphones, speakers or both
Volume changes that respect the hardware knob and fade in safely
A TotalMix-style mixer per output, a routing grid, scenes and undo
